summary: Before authorized publication, audit and repair stale claim fields across the unpublished range and pass the publication contract.
Require decisive-test predictions to identify inputs capable of changing each outcome, excluding quantities fixed by existing bounds.
Test whether polynomial-matrix repair on rank-two modules beats scalar multiplier degree while preserving a protected class.
Study minimum stacked-error rank over approximator parameter varieties using bounded-rank matrix spaces and determinantal geometry.
Check that suggestions credited to reviewers actually occur in their saved reports rather than originating with the author.
Test genuinely multilinear repairs of product proofs, beyond line-by-line module transformations that reduce to scalar multiplication.
List living-section questions deferred to the scheduled review so each is explicitly addressed when that review begins.
List statement hypotheses absent from the proof so restrictions copied from an instance are checked before review.
Expose a closure's linear consequences and defined variables before choosing a decisive computation on that instance.
Seek product-code structure giving genuine joint-row-space savings for paid errors while retaining a surviving multiplier and full degree budget.
Use the cheaper tuple-to-pencil reserve to test structural product-code rank savings on actual errors with fixed domain survival.
Require the Unreviewed label beside each current-cycle mathematical conclusion, not merely once above an entire list.
Require a current-turn registry search before replies claim record coverage or present a direction as unexplored.
Reformulate certified repair for circuit-size proof systems, testing which soundness, killing and survival obligations survive without degree bounds.
Determine when hardness of tensor-product systems transfers back along multiplication and what degree cost the converse requires.
Test branch-wise repairs in the degree band where gluing exceeds budget, starting with a small functional-pigeonhole instance.
Require an attempt for every reading of a queue item's question before marking it Developed or Closed.
Label unproved trends or expectations in replies as untested hypotheses unless a cited proof or discriminating test supports them.
Match a Meta paragraph to the specific change implementing it, not merely a file edited for another purpose in the turn.
Check whether the proof step actually needs a field or characteristic hypothesis instead of accepting a descriptive without-it clause.
Require replies to quote the applicable refusal rule before retrying a blocked step.
Reject claim-spec figures absent from the draft supplied to the reviewer, using an explicit spec-to-draft pairing.
Verify reviewer messages target the current cycle's reviewer, or explicitly identify the other cycle involved.
Require judged true-catch and false-refusal labels in replay evidence for new checks, with matching commit-message counts.
Prevent reviewer messages from referencing draft files whose prerequisite writes failed or have not completed.
Require answers showing what each listed summary sentence's source actually establishes before the reviewer brief.
Refresh the generic-principal-kernel claim's stale review fields before the next authorized publication.
Make computation scripts identify whether each instance lies in the goal's regime and what out-of-regime outcomes can establish.
Compare quotient common kernels with the best representative pair and sums over representatives to detect genuine mixing survivors.
Compute the larger-board zero-excess pair orbits, comparing representative intersections without assuming distributivity of subspace operations.
Develop an augmenting-chain retargeting of q0 for K at least four to prove the partition-excess conjecture's only-if direction.
Catch multiprocessing function and argument pickling failures in a small preflight before expensive serial setup.
Calibrate uncosted-attempt detection on independently collected phrasings from real reviews rather than examples tailored to the pattern.
Place each explicit witness beside the Plainest bound so simpler candidates are compared before drafting its proof.
Apply condition checks to entry and living-section summaries, including degree-window conditions the current matcher misses.
Flag proof steps carried to another case by likewise or similarly so the named case is actually recomputed.
Distinguish location phrases such as under a heading from added mathematical qualifiers in answer validation.
Distinguish a quoted mistaken no-mistake claim from an assertion that no mistake occurred.
Prevent claim assessments from crediting a completed review while the source entry's gate is absent or still pending.
Check that recorded instances cited as tests actually satisfy the new claim's hypotheses and could contradict it.
Require saved output references beside scan or replay figures in process, prevention and review paragraphs.
